name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted task and project manager with areas, notes, tags, recurring tasks, CalDAV sync and a REST API, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with TUDUDI_USER_EMAIL and the generated TUDUDI_USER_PASSWORD from the environment. The admin account is created on the first start; change TUDUDI_USER_EMAIL before deploying if you want a different address, since editing the password later does not overwrite an existing account.
